title: A test: quantum fragments (with the iron and copper of the deposit) gathered at Thin Breath Haze, Tidewater, into storage at Ramen's Rest, Last Light (one jump)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-22 03:45 UTC (orders.log ENT-061, block ZERO: gather what the reserve lacks, beyond our systems; rules F3, F23, F24, F36, F37). Our home iron and copper stand above their max (gather-gsc-0027-spacetime-seep reads full: iron 174,768 of max 108,500, fill.py 03:28 UTC) and the near fields of the short ores read empty, so the class takes its work further out (F23). The reserve is short of 3,702 quantum fragments (surplus.py reserve, 03:05 UTC; grow_quantum_dot_matrix for the core foundry and the station core). Thin Breath Haze read 481 quantum fragments, 3,919 iron and 3,924 copper (table fields, read 0.5 h before 03:20 UTC); the route maker rates quantum fragments minable with the laser (candidate mine-veil-nebula, no module warning). What share of a load the fragments make is what this test reads. The road from home passes Kitalpha (7 pirates seen in 24 hours, none in the last 6, data/intel/sightings.jsonl 03:40 UTC): one ship, hold empty on the way out (F3). A test of three results (F37): on one field, one ship three times; stores everything, sells nothing (F24).
